description: This is a test class for the EmployeeMembershipDao in the OrangeHRM project. It contains various unit tests for CRUD operations and search functionalities related to EmployeeMembership entities within the Human Resource Management system.

classes.name: EmployeeMembershipDaoTest
classes.description: A unit test class extending TestCase to verify the functionality of EmployeeMembershipDao methods, including CRUD operations and searches.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, sets up the EmployeeMembershipDao instance, and populates test data from a YAML fixture.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeMembershipById
methods.description: Tests retrieving an EmployeeMembership by ID and verifies its properties.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeMembership
methods.description: Tests searching EmployeeMembership data based on filter parameters.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeMembershipWithLimit
methods.description: Tests search with limiting the number of returned results.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeMembership
methods.description: Tests creating and saving a new EmployeeMembership entity.

methods.name: testEditEmployeeMembership
methods.description: Tests editing an existing EmployeeMembership and saving changes.

methods.name: testGetSearchEmployeeMembershipsCount
methods.description: Verifies the count of EmployeeMemberships matching search filter.
